features: HD Projector with 720p Native Resolution – Crisp, Detailed Visuals Unlock stunning picture quality with true 720p native resolution. Whether you're streaming your favourite movies, playing games, or delivering presentations, the Beem 520 home projector offers razor-sharp images and vibrant colours for an immersive viewing experience.

Bright Projector with 2200 Lumens – Clear in Any Room Designed for all lighting conditions, the Beem 520 delivers impressive 2200 lumens of brightness. Enjoy crystal-clear visuals during the day or night, indoors or outdoors—perfect for home theaters, classrooms, offices, or backyard movie nights.

Tilt-Adjustable Projection with Built-In Telescopic Stand Achieve the perfect viewing angle every time. The integrated telescopic stand and adjustable tilt design allow you to quickly position the screen for optimal clarity and comfort—no extra tripod or accessories needed.

Auto Keystone Correction – Flawless Image Alignment Say goodbye to distorted screens. With built-in automatic vertical keystone correction, the projector instantly adjusts your image for a clean, professional-looking projection from virtually any angle or position.

Seamless Wireless Connectivity with Bluetooth & Wi-Fi Stream movies, TV shows, or mirror your screen effortlessly with built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Connect wirelessly to smartphones, tablets, laptops, or speakers for a clutter-free, all-in-one home entertainment system.
